name: heirloom-site
description: heirloomapp.io rebuilt: Astro, rendered ahead of time, interactive marks reference. Data comes from the app's mark tables (npm run data:sync).

scripts.build: node scripts/prebuild.mjs && astro build && node scripts/legacy.mjs && pagefind --site dist
scripts.deploy:preview: SITE_PREVIEW=1 npm run build && wrangler deploy
